title: Increase MATRIX_LR from 0.04 to 0.06
description: Accelerated Muon optimizer learning rate for transformer matrix parameters to improve convergence in fixed 5-minute budget
reflection: Success! val_bpb 0.996146 beats baseline 0.996598 by 0.000452. The hypothesis that MATRIX_LR was too conservative in a time-limited window held. This is the first improvement across both previous rounds. Rounds 0-1 showed that schedule tuning and capacity addition both failed; this result suggests the path forward is optimizer acceleration on the existing model architecture. VRAM increased marginally (45GB vs 44GB baseline), well within acceptable range.
